page.overview:
Who is Alexis Lazlo?

Alexis Lazlo was an ambassador that lived during the Age of Reckoning, bringing like her ancestor, Pieter Lazlo, a message to Lothern to the Phoenix King Finubar with a request identical to the one of her ancestor, to join Emperor Karl Franz in the impending war.
